description: Staff Activities: the table exists (id + timestamps only) and the controller is a stub (index only, returns hardcoded data). Add 8 columns via a new migration, fill the model, build full CRUD in the controller, register a resource route, create create/edit views, and rewrite index.blade.php to use real DB data and live action buttons. Replace the inline sidebar with the shared farm-sidebar partial.
steps: 1. Run: php artisan make:migration add_fields_to_staff_activities_table. In the generated migration up(): $table->string('staff_name'); $table->string('role'); $table->string('assignment'); $table->string('shift'); $table->string('activity'); $table->string('status')->default('Scheduled'); $table->date('activity_date'); $table->text('notes')->nullable(); In down(): drop each column. File: database/migrations/<timestamp>_add_fields_to_staff_activities_table.php.
2. Run: php artisan migrate. Verify it exits 0.

3. Edit app/Models/StaffActivity.php: replace empty class body with protected $fillable = ['staff_name','role','assignment','shift','activity','status','activity_date','notes'] and protected function casts(): array { return ['activity_date' => 'date']; }.

4. Edit app/Http/Controllers/StaffActivityController.php: replace stub with full resource controller. index(): $activities = StaffActivity::latest()->paginate(15); $todayCount = StaffActivity::whereDate('activity_date', today())->count(); $completedCount = StaffActivity::where('status','Completed')->count(); $totalCount = StaffActivity::count(); $upcomingRecord = StaffActivity::where('status','Scheduled')->whereDate('activity_date','>=',today())->orderBy('activity_date')->first(); return view('staff-activities.index', compact('activities','todayCount','completedCount','totalCount','upcomingRecord')). create(): return view('staff-activities.create'). store(): validate all 8 fields (staff_name/role/assignment/shift/activity required string max:255; status required in:['Scheduled','In Progress','Completed','Cancelled']; activity_date required date; notes nullable string max:5000). Create record, redirect to index with flash. edit(StaffActivity $staffActivity): return view('staff-activities.edit', compact('staffActivity')). update(Request $request, StaffActivity $staffActivity): same validation, update, redirect with flash. destroy(StaffActivity $staffActivity): delete, redirect with flash.

5. Edit routes/web.php: inside the auth middleware group, replace the bare Route::get('/staff-activities',...) with Route::resource('staff-activities', StaffActivityController::class). Add use App\Http\Controllers\StaffActivityController; at top if not present.

6. Create resources/views/staff-activities/create.blade.php: wrap in <x-app-layout>. Full lg:flex layout. Use @include('layouts.farm-sidebar', ['active' => 'staff-activities']). Top header bar (white, university name, date, user dropdown — copy from breedings/index pattern). Page background bg-[#f4f7f3]. Card: rounded-2xl border border-[#dfe8e1] bg-white. Form fields: staff_name (text input), role (select: Veterinarian/Technician/Vocational Worker/Team Leader/Other), assignment (text), shift (text, e.g. 06:00-14:00), activity (text), status (select: Scheduled/In Progress/Completed/Cancelled), activity_date (date input, default today), notes (textarea). Input style: rounded-xl border border-[#d3e1d8] focus:border-green-600 focus:ring-green-600. Primary button: bg-[#123e31] rounded-xl text-white. Secondary (Cancel) button: border border-[#d3e1d8] bg-white rounded-xl text-[#173d31]. Show @if($errors->any()) validation error block. Show session('success')/session('error') flash.

7. Create resources/views/staff-activities/edit.blade.php: mirror create.blade.php. Change form action to route('staff-activities.update', $staffActivity) with @method('PUT') @csrf. Pre-fill all fields using old('field', $staffActivity->field) — use $staffActivity->activity_date->format('Y-m-d') for date.

8. Edit resources/views/staff-activities/index.blade.php: a) Replace the inline <aside> block with @include('layouts.farm-sidebar', ['active' => 'staff-activities']). b) Replace hardcoded $scheduleRows @php block with real $activities data. c) Update stat cards: 'On today's schedule' = $todayCount, 'Tasks completed' = $completedCount.'/'.$totalCount, 'Upcoming shift' = $upcomingRecord?->shift ?? '—' and $upcomingRecord?->activity ?? 'No upcoming shifts'. d) In the schedule table, change @foreach($scheduleRows as $row) to @forelse($activities as $activity), accessing $activity->staff_name, $activity->role, $activity->assignment, $activity->shift, $activity->activity, $activity->status. e) Wire 'Add Activity' button to route('staff-activities.create'). f) Replace View/Edit buttons (currently just <button> placeholders) with real links: Edit -> <a href='route(staff-activities.edit,$activity)'>; Delete -> <form method='POST' action='route(staff-activities.destroy,$activity)'>@csrf @method('DELETE')<button type='submit'>...</button></form>. g) Update pagination section to use $activities->links() (Laravel pagination component) or keep manual previous/next links using $activities->previousPageUrl() etc.
acceptance_criteria: php artisan migrate runs without error
GET /staff-activities/create renders the create form with all 8 fields
Submitting the create form stores a record and redirects to index with success flash
The index table shows real DB records (not hardcoded demo data)
Edit icon links to the pre-filled edit form; submitting it updates the record
Stat cards on index reflect real DB counts
verification: Submit and verify record appears in index
Click Edit, change a field, submit, verify update
findings: Route model binding param confirmed: staff-activities={staff_activity}. Migration added 8 columns (staff_name, role, assignment, shift, activity, status, activity_date, notes) to existing staff_activities table via new migration — did NOT modify original. StaffActivity model filled with $fillable and casts(). Controller replaced with full CRUD: index passes todayCount/completedCount/totalCount/upcomingRecord to view. Route changed from bare get to Route::resource inside auth group — 7 routes confirmed. Index view: inline <aside> replaced with @include farm-sidebar partial, hardcoded $scheduleRows replaced with real $activities, stat cards wired to controller variables, action buttons wired to edit/destroy routes. Create, edit, show views created with matching theme (bg-[#123e31] primary button, rounded-xl inputs, rounded-2xl cards).
